instruction: Chrome autofill keeps filling in the wrong information on forms. I want to completely disable the autofill feature. How can I turn it off?

parameters.command: echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt update -y && echo {CLIENT_PASSWORD} | sudo -S apt install jq -y
cd /home/user/.config/google-chrome/Default && jq '. + {"autofill":{"enabled": true}}' Preferences > temp && mv temp Preferences
